Title: Salesforce Master Data Analyst
Description: Salesforce Master Data Analyst — Software RenewalsLocation: Guadalajara, Jalisco, Mexico (Hybrid — 1 day/week in office) Schedule: Full-time (40 hrs/week) | Local hours with overlap into US Central Time About the Role We are looking for an analytical, detail-oriented Salesforce Master Data Analyst to join our Design to Operate (DTO) Software CRM & Sales Automation team. In this hands-on, high-volume data role, you will serve as the critical link between raw renewals order reports and clean, actionable opportunities in Salesforce. Before a software renewal can become a sales opportunity, someone must determine which customer it belongs to, verify if the account already exists across enterprise master systems, resolve duplicates, and ensure the data is clean enough to load. This is far more than standard data entry—it requires investigative judgment to decide whether two records represent the same company, and the discipline to document the evidence behind every decision. Key Responsibilities Order Cleanup & Party Classification: Isolate records requiring mastering from raw renewals order reports across multiple party fields ( End Customer, Ship To, Sold To, Reseller ). Classify party types per order (recognizing a company may act as an end customer on one order and a reseller on another), standardize address/state picklist values prior to upload, and consolidate multiple product lines per customer. Account Matching & Disposition: Match end customers to unique enterprise customer IDs across Salesforce and internal master databases, documenting the supporting evidence for every match. Route accounts based on data quality and system presence, create missing Salesforce accounts, flag duplicates with full comparison packs (aliases, former names, address variants, order history), and compile legal entity evidence packs when new master IDs are needed. Data Loading & Error Resolution: Build Account Loader and Data Migration files, verifying pre-upload that orders or opportunities do not already exist in Salesforce. Process success and error logs by splitting failures by reason code, correcting defects, rebuilding files, and reconciling loaded records back to the master list. Process Improvement & Rule Definition: Spot recurring data defects, name variants, or upload failure codes. Document these patterns clearly so Product Owners and Salesforce Developers can build automated validation or matching rules, then test those rules against real production data. Build lightweight Excel reconciliation templates and lookups to streamline daily workflows. Agile Execution: Manage all work transparently within Jira, maintain up-to-date standard operating procedures (SOPs) so queues remain transferable, and report on throughput, match accuracy, and blockers. Required Qualifications Experience: 3–5 years of hands-on experience in master data management (MDM), data operations, order management, or CRM data quality. Salesforce Data Expertise: Proven experience working with Salesforce Data Loader or Data Migration templates, Account Loader files, processing success/error files, and troubleshooting upload reason codes. Investigative Judgment: Strong ability to determine whether two records represent the same legal entity using company names, addresses, country data, and order history—and clearly explain your rationale. Comfortable escalating indeterminable records rather than guessing. Advanced Excel Skills: High proficiency in Excel (complex lookups, multi-file reconciliations, handling large datasets without losing rows). Communication: Clear, concise written English to document audit trails and evidence packs for cross-functional stakeholders. Mindset: High precision and stamina under volume, paired with a continuous-improvement mindset that treats repeating manual fixes as problems to solve. Nice-to-Have Qualifications Fortune 100 or large enterprise experience in customer master data, entitlements, or channel/distributor operations. Exposure to software renewals, subscription order flows, or co-terming. Salesforce Administrator certification or practical experience configuring Salesforce duplicate management rules. Familiarity with Jira and data reconciliation tools/scripting (Power Query, SQL, or Python).

Capacidad para trabajar de forma autónoma y gestionar prioridades. Facilidad para colaborar con equipos multidisciplinarios e internacionales. Title: Advisory Analyst

Title: GEO Expert - Hybrid
Description: Clara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation. More than 50,000 leading and fast-growing businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the region's fastest-growing company. We're passionate about helping every company we work with become more effective—and, through that, raising the region's competitiveness. We're ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others. GEO Expert Location: Mexico, Brasil, Colombia or Argentina What you'll do The way people find companies is changing: search is increasingly a conversation with an LLM. You'll own how Clara shows up in that conversation, making sure Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and other AI engines surface Clara accurately and favorably when people ask about corporate cards, bill pay, or spend management in LatAm. You'll work alongside our website and SEO team to build this function from the ground up, using AI not just as a research aid but as the core engine of how you build, test, and ship. Your responsibilities Own GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) for clara.com and other sites: how our content, structure, and data get cited, summarized, and recommended by AI search and answer engines. Audit how Clara currently appears (or doesn't) across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and other LLM-powered search surfaces, and build a baseline to measure against. Design and run experiments: structured data, content formatting, citation-worthy page design, llms.txt-style approaches, and other emerging GEO tactics, then measure what actually moves the needle. Build AI agents and automated pipelines to do this at scale: automated citation and brand-mention tracking across LLM engines, agents that audit and rewrite content for machine readability, and automation tools (n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar) that turn one-off tasks into repeatable systems. Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, v0, or similar) to build your own tooling: scrapers, dashboards, scoring scripts, or internal apps that track GEO performance. Use AI daily as your core workflow: prompting LLMs to audit how they currently see Clara, orchestrating multi-step agent workflows for content analysis, and generating or restructuring content at scale, not just using AI to speed up manual work. Build growth-hacking style tests, fast, scrappy, and quantified, to find what earns visibility in AI answers before best practices are established industry-wide. Create benchmarks and reporting that show leadership what's working, so we can judge whether this function should grow, ideally through a self-serve dashboard you build yourself. Stay ahead of a field that changes monthly: new engines, new ranking signals, new agent frameworks, and new ways AI models decide what to cite. Must haves Experience optimizing a website or content for search, whether traditional SEO, content growth hacking, or early GEO work, with a track record of experiments that moved real metrics (traffic, rankings, citations, qualified leads). Real AI-building experience , not just prompting: you've built agents, automations, or pipelines (n8n, Make, Zapier, custom scripts, or AI coding tools) that do real work without you in the loop every time. Active, daily use of AI tools as part of your real workflow: using LLMs to research, test hypotheses, audit content, and build at speed. Analytical: comfortable setting up your own tracking, reading results honestly, and killing tests that don't work. Creative: this field has no playbook yet. You'll generate hypotheses nobody has tried, not just apply someone else's checklist. Able to move fast and scrappy: this is a new, unproven function, and you're building the process as you go. Comfortable communicating results and tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders. Nice to haves Engineering background or comfort with code: structured data (schema.org), working with APIs, or writing your own scripts and tools. Not mandatory, but a real advantage in a field this technical. Experience with AI agent frameworks or orchestration (multi-step agents, MCP-based workflows, custom GPTs, or similar). Experience with llms.txt, structured data, or other emerging standards for AI-readable content. Experience building programmatic content pipelines (content generated and published at scale via automation). Traditional SEO experience (technical SEO, content strategy, link building) as a foundation to build GEO on top of. Fintech, payments, or B2B SaaS experience. Fluency in more than one of Spanish, Portuguese, or English, given the multi-market, multi-language nature of clara.com. Why Clara A high talent-density team driven to make an impact in Latin America — low ego, high ownership. Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one. An annual learning budget and accelerated development paths. English is our working language, with Spanish and Portuguese every day. How we work Clarity — Open and direct communication: we say what we mean and give context where it matters. Simplicity — If it can be simpler, it should be. Ownership — We own everything we do, end to end. When something needs to happen, we don't wait. Pride — We hold ourselves to a high standard, and it shows in what we deliver. ABC (Always Be Changing) — We adapt fast, embrace change, and keep learning. Inclusivity — Diverse ideas, stories and perspectives build a better Clara. If you meet the must-haves, apply — the nice-to-haves are a bonus, not a requirement.

Title: Amazon Access Program Manager, Amazon Payments
Description: Description Amazon Access is Amazon's co-branded credit card program in Mexico, operated in partnership with Invex, one of Mexico's leading financial institutions. We are building the financial product that enables millions of Mexican customers to access credit, shop on Amazon, and engage with a rewards ecosystem - all within a highly regulated fintech environment. We are looking for a Program Manager III to own and drive critical workstreams across regulatory influence, payment performance, financial modeling, customer analytics, and operational automation. This role sits at the intersection of product, finance, data, and external partner management, requiring someone who can translate complex data into actionable strategy, influence partners and regulators without formal authority, and deliver measurable business outcomes. You will work directly with Amazon, Invex, payment processors (PROSA), and external partners (Mastercard) to solve high-impact problems end-to-end. SQL proficiency and data analytics are foundational requirements - you will build analytical frameworks, write queries, design dashboards, and use data to drive every decision. Key job responsibilities Own end-to-end program delivery across payment performance, customer acquisition, engagement analytics, and operational automation workstreams for Amazon Access Mexico. Build and maintain analytical frameworks using SQL, QuickSight, and GenAI tools to diagnose business problems, quantify impact, and inform strategy - including cohort segmentation, funnel analysis, and customer persona targeting. Influence external partners (Invex, PROSA, Mastercard) and regulators (CNBV) via evidence-based analysis and persistent engagement to drive outcomes without formal authority. Design financial models, unit economics frameworks, and attribution methodologies to evaluate program sustainability and inform funding decisions. Identify and execute automation opportunities that eliminate manual operational burden across Finance, Accounting, Product, and FinOps teams. Monitor and recover key payment metrics (PSR, ASR, Share of Wallet) via root cause analysis, transaction-level diagnostics, and cross-company coordination. Translate complex data into stakeholder-compelling narratives for senior leadership, supporting WBR/MBR/QBR cycles and strategic planning (OP1/OP2). Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Tech, Finance, BI, and external partners to deliver against the Amazon Access roadmap. A day in the life In this role, you shape the financial product that brings credit access to millions of customers in Mexico. One morning you build the evidence case that convinces a banking regulator to change policy - the next, you diagnose a payment authorization anomaly across three companies and drive the fix before it impacts customers. You design the financial architecture behind a rewards program, model its unit economics, and present the go/no-go recommendation to leadership. You write SQL to uncover why acquisition spiked during a High Value Event, then turn that insight into the strategy for the next one. No two days look the same because you own the full spectrum - from regulatory influence and partner negotiation to data analysis and automation design. This is a role where analytical rigor directly translates into business impact at scale, and where you operate with the autonomy of a founder inside one of the world's most customer-obsessed companies. About The Team Amazon Access Mexico is Amazon's co-branded credit card program, built in partnership with Invex. Our mission is to expand financial access for Mexican customers via a product that combines credit, e-commerce, and rewards. We operate in a complex, regulated fintech environment that requires deep collaboration with banking partners, payment processors, and regulators. Our team is small, high-impact, and data-driven — every team member owns significant workstreams end-to-end. We value analytical rigor, Ownership, and the ability to influence outcomes across organizational boundaries. Basic Qualifications 5+ years of program or project management experience Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership Bachelor's degree or equivalent Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English Preferred Qualifications 2+ years of driving process improvements experience Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. Title: Manager I, Operations
Description: Description Amazon Mexico is looking for a strategic thinker and analytical -focused Business Specialist who is highly motivated with a prominent Capacity Planning background. Air transportation is a critical Middle-Mile solution in Amazon's logistics network, rapidly connecting Fulfillment Centers to Last Mile delivery services. This role combines sophisticated air network optimization with hands-on operational planning. The position requires expertise in translating complex demand forecasts into actionable operational requirements while managing capacity across multiple nodes. The role is critical in ensuring network efficiency, cost optimization, and service excellence through strategic capacity management, precise resource allocation, and continuous performance monitoring. The ideal candidate bridges analytical expertise with operational knowledge to drive network performance and support business growth. The role will be based in Mexico City. Key job responsibilities Conduct network capacity planning, analysis and optimization: create and execute capacity plans across network nodes, daily implement capacity adjustments with planning team, monitor network performance metrics and address capacity constraints, support optimization initiatives through data-driven analysis Operational Planning: convert forecasts into detailed operational requirements, implement node-specific operational plans, monitor and report on key metrics, maintain capacity dashboards for stakeholder visibility Support and optimize air routes initiatives for efficiency, develop contingency routing plans, balance cost optimization with service levels, work with S&OP team on demand forecasting. A day in the life The day begins early with critical morning reviews of the previous day capacity performance, network-wide utilization and adjustments for a better performance of the actual day. Through focused meetings and data analysis, immediate capacity constraints are addressed and operational requirements are updated based on latest forecasts. During the day, activities center on detailed resource planning and optimization, where node-specific requirements for routes, staffing, and vehicle allocations are generated and fine-tuned. This period involves extensive stakeholder collaboration and real-time capacity adjustments, internal system set up to ensure optimal network performance. Thursdays take on special significance with an enhanced focus on weekly planning. This involves converting forecasts into detailed operational requirements, creating comprehensive node-by-node breakdowns, and setting capacity for the upcoming week. Title: Principal Data Engineer
Description: SOBRE EL PUESTO Y EL EQUIPO En TelevisaUnivision, somos la empresa líder mundial de medios de comunicación en español, llegando a millones de consumidores a través de plataformas digitales, streaming, redes sociales, audio, televisión lineal y eventos en vivo. A medida que continuamos expandiendo nuestra plataforma global de streaming, ViX, estamos realizando importantes inversiones en tecnología, datos e innovación para ofrecer experiencias excepcionales a nuestros suscriptores e impulsar el crecimiento sostenible del negocio a largo plazo. El equipo de Ingeniería de Datos (Data Engineering) diseña, desarrolla y opera pipelines de datos de gran volumen y alta velocidad que impulsan ViX. Estos incluyen eventos de reproducción e interacción de usuarios, datos de suscripciones, información publicitaria y el almacén de datos analíticos (data warehouse), que permite transformar esta información en decisiones de negocio. El equipo colabora estrechamente con las áreas de Ingeniería, Producto, Ciencia de Datos y Analítica de TelevisaUnivision. El Principal Data Engineer desempeñará un papel clave como líder técnico en el diseño, desarrollo e implementación de nuestra plataforma de datos. Será fundamental para definir la arquitectura y la dirección técnica de la plataforma a varios años, participará directamente en la resolución de los desafíos más complejos relacionados con el procesamiento de datos en tiempo real y por lotes (batch), y brindará mentoría a ingenieros de niveles junior e intermedio para elevar los estándares de ingeniería de todo el equipo. El candidato ideal combina una sólida experiencia práctica en sistemas de datos distribuidos y procesamiento de datos en streaming con el criterio necesario para tomar decisiones arquitectónicas de largo plazo, la capacidad de influir y alinear equipos sin autoridad jerárquica directa y un compromiso genuino con el desarrollo profesional de otros ingenieros. SOBRE TI Eres un líder técnico con experiencia práctica que diseña plataformas completas, no solo pipelines de datos. Te sientes igualmente cómodo desarrollando código para entornos de producción, defendiendo decisiones arquitectónicas durante revisiones de diseño, colaborando con ingenieros junior para resolver problemas complejos y explicando las ventajas y desventajas de distintas soluciones a líderes ejecutivos. Cuentas Con Conocimiento experto de los servicios de datos de Google Cloud Platform (GCP), especialmente BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataflow (Apache Beam), Cloud Composer y Cloud Storage. Amplia experiencia en el diseño de arquitecturas en tiempo real y orientadas a eventos, incluyendo semánticas de procesamiento exactamente una vez (exactly-once), manejo de datos que llegan con retraso y evolución de esquemas. Dominio avanzado de Python y SQL, así como de frameworks de transformación de datos como dbt. Experiencia comprobada definiendo la dirección técnica de plataformas utilizadas por múltiples equipos y liderando su implementación a lo largo de varios trimestres. Experiencia con herramientas de Infraestructura como Código (IaC), como Pulumi o Terraform. Excelentes habilidades de resolución de problemas y capacidad para diseñar soluciones escalables y eficientes. Gran atención al detalle y capacidad para gestionar múltiples prioridades de manera efectiva. Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y colaboración, con capacidad para trabajar con equipos técnicos y no técnicos. Mentalidad de mejora continua y pasión por la mentoría y el intercambio de conocimientos. Interés genuino en desarrollar ingenieros junior y fomentar una cultura de ingeniería sólida. RESPONSABILIDADES DEL DÍA A DÍA Arquitectura de la plataforma de datos, desarrollo y estrategia técnica Desarrollar implementaciones de referencia, frameworks y bibliotecas reutilizables que puedan ser adoptadas por otros ingenieros, incluyendo plantillas de ingesta de datos, patrones de dbt y Airflow, y módulos de IaC en Pulumi. Liderar el diseño de pipelines de datos en tiempo real utilizando Pub/Sub y Dataflow, incluyendo esquemas de eventos, registros y evolución de esquemas, procesamiento exactly-once, gestión de marcas de tiempo (watermarking) y manejo de datos que llegan con retraso. Gestionar integralmente los pipelines asignados, desde su diseño y desarrollo hasta las pruebas, implementación y soporte en producción. Garantizar la calidad, integridad, seguridad y disponibilidad de los datos en todo el ecosistema. Colaboración multifuncional Colaborar con Gerentes de Producto, Científicos de Datos, Analistas y equipos de Ingeniería para comprender los requerimientos del negocio y traducirlos en soluciones técnicas. Contribuir a las discusiones sobre arquitectura de datos y a la estrategia de largo plazo de la plataforma. Trabajar con las distintas partes interesadas para identificar oportunidades de mejora de procesos y eficiencia operativa. Rendimiento y optimización Optimizar el almacenamiento, procesamiento y orquestación de datos para mejorar el rendimiento, la escalabilidad y la eficiencia de costos, incluyendo los costos de consultas y almacenamiento en BigQuery. Monitorear, diagnosticar y resolver problemas relacionados con los pipelines y la plataforma de datos, así como contribuir a las revisiones de incidentes. Implementar mejores prácticas de gobierno de datos, observabilidad, pruebas e integración y entrega continuas (CI/CD). Liderar la respuesta ante incidentes graves relacionados con los datos, realizar análisis posteriores a incidentes sin atribución de culpas (blameless postmortems) e impulsar soluciones estructurales para prevenir su recurrencia. Liderazgo y contribución al equipo Brindar mentoría y apoyo a ingenieros de datos junior mediante orientación técnica, revisiones de código e intercambio de conocimientos. Contribuir a las decisiones arquitectónicas y a la definición de mejores prácticas de ingeniería. Participar en entrevistas técnicas y apoyar el desarrollo de un equipo de Ingeniería de Datos de alto desempeño. Evaluar e impulsar la adopción de tecnologías emergentes, incluyendo flujos de trabajo de ingeniería asistidos por inteligencia artificial y herramientas de datos basadas en modelos de lenguaje de gran tamaño (LLM), manteniendo altos estándares de calidad y seguridad. REQUISITOS Y EXPERIENCIA Experiencia y habilidades requeridas Licenciatura o maestría en Ciencias de la Computación, Ingeniería, Sistemas de Información o un campo técnico relacionado, o experiencia equivalente. Más de 12 años de experiencia en Ingeniería de Datos, Data Warehousing o entornos de Big Data. Al menos 2 años de experiencia en un rol de liderazgo técnico (Tech Lead), definiendo la dirección técnica de múltiples equipos. Experiencia demostrable brindando mentoría y desarrollando ingenieros de niveles junior e intermedio. Trayectoria comprobada en el diseño y operación de plataformas de datos en tiempo real y de gran volumen en entornos de producción, por ejemplo, plataformas que procesan miles de millones de eventos al día. Experiencia de nivel experto con GCP: BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataflow (Apache Beam), Cloud Composer (Airflow) y Cloud Storage. También se considerará experiencia con AWS. Dominio experto de Python y SQL, así como experiencia con dbt en entornos de producción. Conocimiento profundo de conceptos de procesamiento de datos en streaming, incluyendo tiempo del evento frente al tiempo de procesamiento, ventanas de procesamiento (windowing), marcas de tiempo (watermarks), entrega exactly-once y mecanismos de control de presión (backpressure); experiencia con Kafka, Flink o Spark. Conocimiento experto en modelado de datos para analítica, incluyendo modelado dimensional, modelado de eventos y formatos de tablas lakehouse como Apache Iceberg. Amplia experiencia con Infraestructura como Código (Pulumi o Terraform), CI/CD y pruebas automatizadas para pipelines de datos. Experiencia demostrable gestionando la confiabilidad de los datos, incluyendo objetivos de nivel de servicio (SLO), observabilidad de datos, gestión de incidentes y análisis posteriores a incidentes. Experiencia comprobada en la reducción de costos de plataformas de datos en la nube a gran escala. Excelentes habilidades de comunicación escrita, verbal y de presentación, incluyendo la elaboración de documentos de diseño y la comunicación con audiencias técnicas y ejecutivas. Requisitos deseables Experiencia en empresas de suscripción, plataformas de video en streaming (OTT), medios de comunicación u organizaciones deportivas, incluyendo datos de calidad de reproducción, interacción de usuarios y publicidad en plataformas con anuncios (AVOD). Experiencia dando soporte a cargas de trabajo de Machine Learning y Ciencia de Datos, incluyendo pipelines de características (feature pipelines), características en tiempo real y datos para sistemas de recomendación y personalización. Experiencia con contratos de datos (data contracts), registros de esquemas (schema registries) y herramientas de catalogación o trazabilidad de datos (data lineage). REQUISITOS DE ELEGIBILIDAD Disponibilidad para trabajar en Ciudad de México. Se verificará la experiencia laboral y académica. Univision es un empleador que ofrece equidad e igualdad de oportunidades. Todos los solicitantes calificados recibirán consideración para el empleo sin distinción de sexo, identidad de género, orientación sexual, raza, color, religión, origen nacional, discapacidad, estado de veterano protegido, edad o cualquier otra característica protegida por la ley.

Title: Strategy Manager
Description: Objetivo de la posición: Desarrollar análisis, diagnósticos y recomendaciones estratégicas que permitan identificar oportunidades de crecimiento y comunicación para las marcas, a partir del entendimiento del consumidor, el mercado, la competencia y la evolución del ecosistema de medios. Será responsable de liderar proyectos estratégicos de manera autónoma, transformando información de distintas fuentes en insights, conclusiones y recomendaciones accionables, así como desarrollar entregables de alta calidad para clientes y stakeholders internos. Integrar información de investigación, data y comportamiento digital para enriquecer las recomendaciones. Traducir los hallazgos en oportunidades de comunicación para las marcas. Media & Communications Strategy Desarrollar estrategias de comunicación y medios alineadas con los objetivos de marca y negocio. Evaluar canales, plataformas, formatos y contextos de comunicación. Construir recomendaciones estratégicas con sustento en data, insights y entendimiento del consumidor. Participar en el desarrollo de planes estratégicos anuales y proyectos de comunicación integrados. Strategic Project Management Liderar proyectos y entregables estratégicos de principio a fin. Asegurar la calidad, consistencia y cumplimiento de los entregables. Identificar riesgos, anticipar necesidades y gestionar prioridades de manera autónoma. Strategic Storytelling & Communication Construir narrativas estratégicas claras y persuasivas. Desarrollar presentaciones ejecutivas que comuniquen hallazgos, implicaciones y recomendaciones. Presentar y defender propuestas ante clientes y stakeholders. Traducir análisis complejos en conclusiones simples, relevantes y accionables. Requerimientos mínimos: 4–6 años de experiencia profesional en agencias de medios, publicidad o áreas de marketing. Experiencia desarrollando análisis estratégicos, investigaciones y recomendaciones para marcas. Experiencia en planeación de medios y entendimiento de ecosistemas de comunicación. Deseable experiencia en categorías de consumo masivo, entretenimiento, retail o marcas de alta competencia. Conocimiento de herramientas de investigación como TGI, Kantar, GWI, Ipsos o equivalentes. Familiaridad con herramientas de análisis de audiencias, inversión publicitaria y competencia. Entendimiento del ecosistema digital, plataformas, formatos y métricas de medios. Manejo avanzado de PowerPoint y capacidad para estructurar presentaciones ejecutivas. Inglés intermedio - avanzado. Competencias clave Pensamiento estratégico. Visión de negocio. Liderazgo de equipos. Capacidad analítica. Storytelling con datos. Influencia y negociación. Orientación al cliente.
